Route 1: Sol-Gel Synthesis of Zn0.1Ni0.9
1. Prepare a solution by dissolving nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate (Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 26.26 g — equivalent to 0.09 mol Ni) and zinc nitrate hexahydrate (Zn(NO3)2·6H2O, 2.97 g — equivalent to 0.01 mol Zn) in 100 mL of double distilled water.
2. Add 2.1 g of citric acid as a chelating agent.
3. Adjust the pH to approximately 7 by adding ammonia solution dropwise.
4. Heat the solution at 80 °C under constant stirring to evaporate the water and form a gel.
5. Dry the gel at 120 °C overnight.
6. Calcine the dried gel in air at 600 °C for 2 hours to obtain the final oxide product.
Final product: Zn0.1Ni0.9 with a cubic crystal structure, spherical shape, and average particle size of 60 × 60 × 60 nm, matching PDF reference number 78-0429.
